scope: Maintainer-controlled, staged feature-removal pilot on an existing published repository. Not an independent user trial or controlled performance benchmark. Feature implementations and tests are authored; reconstruction repairs are produced by the installed Codex CLI. One run per reconstruction workflow, Unmix first. No general speedup claim.

recording.scope: Core API wall time only; editing, setup and human effort are excluded.

unmix.hostIntervention: Maintainer staged the already agent-written repair and called resume/verify after the agent sandbox/approval policy blocked those steps. This is not a fully unattended run.

plainGit.hostIntervention: Maintainer staged the already agent-written resolution because sandbox index writes were unavailable.

independentCliOracle.scope: Maintainer-run external assertion script, not an independent human trial.

failedInitialAttempt: Initial CLI launch inside the outer sandbox failed before model execution. Preserved locally; excluded from successful-run timings.
